[documentation-forward] searchInsights() JSDoc (knowledge-store.ts:183–193) documents case-insensitive text matching but does not mention that the tags intersection filter (tagFilter.every) is case-SENSITIVE. This asymmetry should be explicitly called out in the JSDoc @param for the filters.tags field so callers understand they must pass tags in the exact case stored in the insight. Example: '// @param filters.tags - Case-sensitive intersection filter; use exact casing as stored.'

[documentation-forward] handleListKnowledge JSDoc (api-knowledge.ts:138–148) mentions limit/offset coercion but does not explicitly state that limit=0 is treated as 'no limit' (coerced to undefined). The JSDoc comment 'limit → undefined' covers the NaN/missing case but not the zero case. Add a clarifying line: 'limit=0 is treated as unlimited (mapped to undefined); pass a positive integer to enforce a page size.'

The implementation correctly applies pagination via Array.slice() after all filtering, which is the right order. No performance concerns at the current scale; if insight counts grow into tens of thousands, an indexed/sorted store would be warranted, but this is a future concern, not a current one.
